# ADR-3045: A04: Prefer threat modeling workshops for initiative 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Late design reviews miss structural issues.

## Decision

Delivery teams SHOULD prefer threat modeling workshops for initiative 9 (A04-9) before high-risk launches.

## Consequences

Outputs feed the ADR backlog.
